content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides information on long-acting insulins, including Detemir and Degludec. These insulins are available in U-100 and U-200 formulations. The median Average Wholesale Prices (AWPs) for these insulins range from $370 to $1,242, while the National Average Drug Acquisition Costs (NADAC) range from $295 to $1,147. Glargine is another long-acting insulin available in U-100 and U-300 formulations. The AWPs for Glargine range from $316 to $363, and the NADAC prices range from $107 to $299. Additionally, biosimilar or follow-on products of Glargine are available in U-100 formulations. These biosimilar options have a median AWP of $190 and a NADAC of $95.
